newsitem.title: UK: Govt offers major road schemes to private sector.
newsitem.headline: Govt offers major road schemes to private sector.

text.p: The UK government's Highways Agency on Tuesday offered two major road schemes to the private sector under its private finance initiative, designed to bring private capital into public infrastructure projects.

John Bowis, minister for transport, said in a statement that bids were now being invited to design, build, finance and operate (DBFO) the A40 West London Approach road and the A13 Thames Gateway. "They will relieve congestion on these strategically important routes. And these two DBFO projects break new ground, extending the concept to the urban trunk road network," he said.
